description:
Implement channel promotion endpoint and validation in deployment-manager.

- Only allow promotion up the stability ladder: nightly → beta → stable.
- Promotion creates a new release record with `promoted_from_release_id` pointing to the source release.
- The promoted release inherits the same git commit, artifacts, and version but targets a higher channel.
- Nightly releases skip `CheckReleaseGate` entirely (orchestrator-level bypass).
- Beta and stable promotions call `CheckReleaseGate` to verify required approvals exist.
- Approvals are commit-scoped (no channel dimension) — once a commit is approved for a platform, it can be promoted to any channel without re-approval.
name: dm-channel-promotion-logic
title: Add Channel Promotion Endpoint And Validation To Deployment Manager
